title: TemplateVersionPublished
description: Emitted by the Product Template Service when a new version of a product template is published. Triggers diff computation and fan-out to subscribed engagements. Carries no firm-identifying or client-confidential data.

template_id.description: Identifier of the product template that was updated.

version.description: The newly published version identifier (monotonically increasing per template_id).

published_at.description: UTC timestamp when the version was published.
